Hello, everyone!

notes.title: DLC4 Delayed Release Announcement
notes.notes: Due to some material issues, DLC4 needs to be delayed and will now be released next week. As a result, we will be releasing 2 DLCs simultaneously next week. To show our appreciation to the wide player base, we will be making DLC5 free of charge.

notes.title: New Character DLC to be Released Soon
notes.notes:
After the team's efforts, the new DLCs have all passed the review process and have been published! You can keep an eye out for the release times and get them accordingly.
As a way to show our gratitude for your continued support, we are offering DLC5 for free. We hope you'll enjoy it!
By the way, we've created four different character animations with unique features. Which one do you like the most? We welcome your feedback, as it will be very helpful for our future development work.
Let's all have a great time playing together! If you have any questions, please feel free to let us know, and we'll do our best to assist you.

notes.title: DLC2 was updated
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone! Based on the feedback from players in the comment section, we have promptly optimized the animation for Alya.

The update has now been completed. We welcome any suggestions you may have, so please feel free to contact us at any time.

notes.title: Studio Update
notes.notes:
We are currently in the final stages of polishing our upcoming game "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2819120/_/]Goddess of War[/url]". This game is primarily targeted towards the China region players, and we hope it will provide you with an exciting card battle adventure. Utilize your wisdom to captivate the hearts of the various goddesses~
The game's Steam store page is now live, so feel free to click and add it to your wishlist.

Additionally, we are also developing a new game called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2522920/_/]"Rise & Muse"[/url]. This is our first attempt at creating a card game using 3D technology, and we expect it to release on August 16th. We hope you will follow the development closely and add it to your wishlist as well.
We will continue to work hard to bring you even better gaming experiences. Thank you for your constant support and attention.

notes.title: New Character DLC 2 will be released at 4 PM on May 24th
notes.notes:
After a lengthy review process, DLC2 has finally been approved and will be released tomorrow!
To bring you the content as soon as possible, the development team has already submitted the upcoming DLCs for review, hoping to have them approved quickly so we can share the new content with you. We hope you'll enjoy it!
If you like the DLC, please consider leaving a review - that will help more people discover it.
Thank you all for your support!

In addition, the development team's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2522920/_/]new project[/url] is in active development. The entire team is working hard, putting in extra hours to bring it to you as soon as possible. We look forward to sharing it with you soon!

notes.title: Version 1.0.7 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! First of all, we want to express our gratitude for your support in our game. You guys are absolutely amazing! Today, we bring you the V1.0.7 version update, and let me tell you, this update is really something special! We've addressed two issues, and I'm going to tell you about them right away! Listen up:

Did you know? In the 1600*900 resolution, the "Skip Story" button mysteriously disappeared! Isn't that strange? But don't worry, we've brought it back in this version! Now you can freely skip the storyline to your heart's content!

We know that some players may get stuck in battles and not know what to do, right? Well, we're the thoughtful game developers! So, we've added a super bonus for you! After failing once, you can choose to "Skip Battle" and easily get rid of those pesky enemies! Pretty amazing, huh? We've gone the extra mile to save you some brain cells. We really put a lot of thought into it!

So, dear players, please continue to stay tuned for our updates! We will keep working hard to bring you more laughter and surprises! Thank you all! We love you! 😄

notes.title: DLC Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We sincerely appreciate your support for "Muse War".

Our development team is preparing to release DLC with more exciting content for you. The first DLC will introduce two new characters, Helfina and Victoria, based on the results of the recent voting. If you'd like to participate in the voting, you can visit the following website: https://tp.wjx.top/vm/t758E0g.aspx#

We have plans to create DLC for each character in the future, so stay tuned for more updates.

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Based on your feedback over the past period, we have further optimized the combat system of the game to reduce issues with the flow of battles getting stuck.

Furthermore, in response to your feedback, we have implemented a skip feature for post-victory scenes, allowing you to progress through the game more quickly and enjoy the subsequent gameplay with ease.

We deeply apologize for any bugs or negative experiences you may have encountered previously. We are committed to providing timely updates to enhance your gaming enjoyment.

Additionally, our development team is considering the release of a DLC that will offer additional perks and content for the characters. We greatly appreciate your continued support!

Thank you for your understanding and support!

Update Date: March 18, 2024

notes.title: V1.0.3 Updated
notes.notes:
Updates for this game:

1. When making interactions, if you choose the wrong location, a prompt will now appear to inform you to select another place.
2. Added a skip button for the main storyline. You can now freely skip the main storyline.
3. The memory panel has been enhanced with zoom-in and zoom-out buttons, and the camera movement can be controlled using the mouse. The basic functionality has been implemented in the current version, and further optimizations will be made in future updates.
We hope that friends who have purchased the game can provide feedback and reviews, so that more players can get to know us. Thank you! Our studio will strive to meet everyone's needs.
